title: New upper bound for the Ramsey number of odd cycles
summary: The \emph{$k$-color Ramsey number} $R_k(C_{2\ell+1})$ is the least integer $n$ such that any $k$-edge-coloring of a complete graph $K_n$ has a monochromatic odd cycle $C_{2\ell+1}$. Axenovich, Cames van Batenburg, Janzer, Michel, and Rundström~(JCT-B, 2026) recently proved \[ R_k(C_{2\ell+1})\le (4\ell-2)^k k^{k/\ell}+1, \] and Miyazaki, Mulrenin, Pohoata, and Zheng further improved the factor $k^{k/\ell}$ to $(k!)^{1/\ell}$.
